delivery.outcome: Bound native post-run verification to a finite configurable deadline, retain sanitized environment and injected runner compatibility, and publish through protected validation and merge.
nonGoals: No lifecycle persistence or IDE cache redesign
No non-POSIX process-tree implementation; unsupported native hosts fail explicitly

architecture.decision: Add PostRunVerifyConfig.timeout_seconds defaulting to 300. Reuse the POSIX bounded loop executor through a private sanitized adapter. Preserve run_verify_commands and custom two-argument runner signatures; injected runners own their execution bounds. Invalid deadlines produce not_run; timeout returns failure 124 and stops later commands.
interfaceChanges: PostRunVerifyConfig and its YAML block accept timeout_seconds
architecture.rollback: Revert this runtime and regression-test change together.

commands: python -m pytest -q tests/test_post_run_verify_boundaries.py tests/test_post_run_verify.py tests/test_post_run_verify_env.py tests/test_loop.py
validation.evidence: Real bounded subprocess, invalid config, fail-fast ordering, stock/custom runner and environment regressions
